title: Smart Switch
summary: Serve a tiny web page and control an LED from the virtual phone.

briefing.text: Serve a tiny web page and control an LED from the virtual phone.
Build the circuit, write the program, then use the live objectives and hints to check each connection.

learn.title: WiFi
learn.body:
Serve a tiny web page and control an LED from the virtual phone.

The HTTP callback controls GPIO18, so connect its resistor/LED circuit before running.

Wait for WiFi connection, register your routes and call server.begin(). Keep server.handleClient() in loop.

Open the Phone tab, load /, then follow Turn on. The /on callback must set GPIO18 HIGH and send a response containing ON.
